title: jurinea mollis subsp. anatolica
intro: Jurinea mollis subsp. anatolica, commonly known as Anatolian Jurinea, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Jurinea mollis subsp. anatolica include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
